theory.target: On Hirzebruch surfaces, test Euler-zero and base-window acyclicity shortcuts and derive the corrected total-cohomology criterion.
definitions: Fn=P(O plus O(n)), n>=0, over a characteristic-zero field, in quotient convention.
Negative section S and fibre F satisfy S^2=-n,S.F=1,F^2=0; H=S+nF and K=-2S-(n+2)F.
L=O(aS+bF) for integers a,b; immaculate means all Hq including H0 vanish.
Euler characteristic is h0-h1+h2 and is not a cohomology dimension.
The fan has rays (0,1),(1,0),(0,-1),(-1,n), consecutive cones, divisor coefficients(a,b,0,0).
assumptions: Characteristic-zero field; exact rational Cech ranks model the smooth complete toric surface Fn.
Negative section S has S^2=-n, fibre F has F^2=0 and S.F=1; D=aS+bF.
Fn=P(O plus O(n)) in quotient convention; S=H-nF. Immaculate means all cohomology including H0 vanishes.
Fan rays are (0,1),(1,0),(0,-1),(-1,n), with consecutive maximal cones and divisor coefficients (a,b,0,0).
All-degree classification and geometric Cech/projection bridges are ordinary derivations pending independent review.
No mirror equivalence, Floer computation, general toric-stack criterion, novelty or parent solution is claimed.
approaches_considered: Projection to P1, symmetric-power splitting and Serre duality derive complete cohomology and the locus.
Independent affine-cover Cech matrices plus complete integer character regions verify cohomology.
Euler-zero or base-window-only shortcuts are retired by explicit twisted examples.
falsification_targets: Euler characteristic zero suffices for total acyclicity.
The product-space b=-1 window survives every twist.
The displayed canonical entry in the source immaculate list has vanishing cohomology.

claims.statement: Euler characteristic zero implies immaculate on every Hirzebruch surface. The F2 negative-section line bundle refutes this with cohomology dimensions (1,1,0).
claims.falsification_condition: A wrong fan/divisor identification, class weight, cocycle equation or quotient rank.

claims.statement: The product-space base-coordinate window b=-1 suffices after twisting. On F2 the bundle O(S-F) has cohomology (0,2,0), unlike the same coordinates on F0.
claims.falsification_condition: An incorrect twist convention, projection summand or Cech calculation.

claims.statement: Over characteristic zero, on Fn the complete immaculate locus is a=-1 or b=-1 for n=0, and a=-1 or (a,b)=(0,-1),(-2,-n-1) for n>0. The index-zero dimensions in theory.md hold for arbitrary integer degrees.
claims.falsification_condition: A missing direct-image summand, wrong Serre-dual shift, parity exception or failed Cech-to-geometry bridge.

claims.statement: Two algorithms agree on 1827 bundles and the complete row digest, with 36841 nonzero character classes,223 immaculate cases,27 Euler false acceptances and42 b=-1 false acceptances.
claims.falsification_condition: An omitted tuple, unbounded nonacyclic character region, mismatched row or rank.

claims.statement: Eight bundle certificates with26 character-class vectors and7 canonical non-boundary certificates pass;7 bundle and4 canonical corruptions are rejected.
claims.falsification_condition: An accepted invalid weight, noncocycle, boundary, incomplete basis or specified corruption.

claims.statement: Hochenegger arXiv:2006.16553v4 Examples2.7 and4.6 display the same divisor (n-2)F-2C_+ as canonical and in the immaculate list. PDF text and HTML agree. This is a source-level discrepancy, not a main-theorem or author-status adjudication. Stacks01XS provides the projective-bundle normalization and cohomology dependencies.
claims.falsification_condition: A wrong transcription, version, locator or convention.

claims.statement: In the frozen fan model, the displayed canonical divisor has a nonzero degree-two class. For n=2 it has Betti(0,0,1), whereas K+F has(0,0,0). The proposed adjacent coefficient repair requires human review.
claims.falsification_condition: A failed canonical-character inequality, cocycle or separating functional, or different source divisor convention.

progress.summary: On F2,O(S) has(1,1,0) despite Euler zero, and O(S-F) has(0,2,0) despite b=-1; explicit weight cocycles certify the failures.
Replace the product-coordinate shortcut by the stated complete Hirzebruch immaculate locus; identify the source boundary K versus K+F.
